changes.to: Maker pages checked 2026-11-25: four feedback servos, one motor per leg driving shoulder and knee, backward-compatible OpenCat firmware (Petoi says it will open-source the Quaddle code before delivery), two ESP32-S3 boards (motion, and AI on Buddy/Scout) with a Raspberry Pi Zero socket, gyroscope and PIR on every model, gesture/light/IR distance sensors and an optional AI vision module on Scout, blocks/MicroPython/Python/C++/ROS programming.
